name: claude-constitution-layer-kit
description: The constitution kit: a portable governance layer for Claude Code projects, one plugin per module

plugins.name: const-catalogs
plugins.description: Numbered kinds: a catalogued document's file name and id are one name, <prefix>-<nnnn>-<slug>; a new item's number must be free, and no two items of a catalog share one. Catalogs are declared in this module's own dial. Plus a skill for taking a number, renumbering after a collision, listing and citing.

plugins.name: const-decision-records
plugins.description: Write-time gate on decision records: a document governed by a record policy carries type task-record, stakes (process | product | architecture) and a decider. Plus skills for pricing and recording a decision, and for promoting recurring commit notes.

plugins.name: const-doc-budgets
plugins.description: A character ceiling per group of documents, measured after every write and in a scan: each ceiling names its documents by path patterns, its number and the days of data it was set from, and warns until 30 days of data stand behind it; a history report over git gives those data; a document that must stand over its ceiling is declared as a departure in the dials file. Plus a skill for setting a ceiling and reading a finding.

plugins.name: const-interaction
plugins.description: Answer in the shape the question has, the answer first; every assumption listed, every list item addressable; honesty over agreement; stop before a hard-to-reverse act and wait for a yes, with a gate on enumerated destructive commands.

plugins.name: const-language
plugins.description: Plain prose in governed documents, checked by Vale after every write and in a scan: a Flesch–Kincaid grade ceiling, a words-per-sentence limit, idioms and formal phrases plain language avoids, formal words with a plain replacement, passive voice reported — every threshold and level a dial, a departure declared in the dials file and never marked in the document. Plus a skill that applies the rules while writing and reads a finding.

plugins.name: const-locations
plugins.description: Documents born in their canonical home: a command derives the home from the policy's territory, proves it resolves to exactly that policy, and writes the document from the kind's template with a valid envelope; a skill for creating documents through it and one for introducing a new kind — policy first, then territory, then document.

plugins.name: const-meta-types
plugins.description: Write-time guard of claimed territory: every Markdown document there carries the envelope (id, type, title, status) and resolves to exactly one governing policy. Plus a skill for choosing the meta-type.

plugins.name: const-questions
plugins.description: Ask only at recorded stakes or a genuine blocker, else decide and note; one decision per message in a fixed shape — lettered options with pros and cons, one recommendation, the decider named — printed at every session start; questions derived from open slots, closed vocabularies as the options, defaults with override, vague input restated; no open question inside a deliverable, with a gate on open-question markers in delivered documents.

plugins.name: const-referencing
plugins.description: References a machine can follow and a move can repair: one written form per kind of reference, anchors that do not depend on a heading's words, a check of the whole tree after every write and in the scan, and a mover that repairs the links a move breaks. Plus a skill for citing, anchoring and moving, and two always-on sentences about references in chat.

plugins.name: const-styling
plugins.description: One style guide every governed document follows — diagrams, prose against lists and tables, list and table format, headings, code blocks, emphasis, callouts — with departures declared per territory or per document in the dials file with a reason; a scan reports the traces of the defaults that no departure allows. Plus a skill that applies the defaults before a diagram, a table, a formula or a template is written.

plugins.name: const-task-close
plugins.description: Task close as a single act: a change that touches code covered by current-state documents updates them or declares no impact; a close procedure that merges deltas, deletes working files and sets the record inactive; and a dirty tree at turn end warned or blocked.
